basic.name: Swing Dance Etiquette
basic.description_template: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Trailblazer's ATK to a single target enemy.

skill.name: Halftime to Make It Rain
skill.description_template: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{damage}}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to a single target enemy and additionally deals DMG for 4 times, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to {{damage}}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to a random enemy.

talent.name: Full-on Aerial Dance
talent.description_template: The Trailblazer immediately regenerates {{energy}} Energy when an enemy target's Weakness is Broken.

technique.name: Now! I'm the Band!
technique.description: After the Technique is used, at the start of the next battle, all allies' Break Effect increases by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

ultimate.name: All-Out Footlight Parade
ultimate.description_template: Grants all allies the Backup Dancer effect, lasting for 3 turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Trailblazer's every turn. Allies with the Backup Dancer effect have their Break Effect increased by {{break_effect}}%. And when they attack enemy targets that are in the Weakness Broken state, the Toughness Reduction of the attack will be converted into 1 instance of Super Break DMG.

2.name: Dance With the One
2.description: When the number of enemy targets on the field is 5 (or more)/4/3/2/1, the Super Break DMG triggered by the Backup Dancer effect increases by 20%/30%/40%/50%/60%.

4.name: Shuffle Along
4.description: When using Skill, additionally increases the Toughness Reduction of the first instance of DMG by 100%.

6.name: Hat of the Theater
6.description: After ally targets break weakness, additionally delays the action of the enemy target by 30%.

eidolons.name: Best Seat in the House
eidolons.description: After using Skill for the first time, immediately recovers 1 Skill Point(s).

eidolons.name: Jailbreaking Rainbowwalk
eidolons.description: When the battle starts, the Trailblazer's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by 25%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Sanatorium for Rest Notes
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Dove in Tophat
eidolons.description: While the Trailblazer is on the field, increases the Break Effect of all teammates (excluding the Trailblazer), by an amount equal to 15% of the Trailblazer's Break Effect.

eidolons.name: Poem Favors Rhythms of Old
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Tomorrow, Rest in Spotlight
eidolons.description: The number of additional DMG applications by the Skill increases by 2.
